# The Blazic Collective

> A mother-daughter creative company in Monticello, Indiana. Piper is a cottage baker serving small-batch stuffed cookies and FroDo, plus handmade things and gift wrapping services. Brittani runs operations.

Every order leaves with a kraft tag stamped with the BC monogram and one line in Piper's handwriting.

## Lines

- [Blazic Bakes](https://theblazics.com/bakes): Baked goods in small batches. Drops every Saturday. Preorders any day. Weekly staples are stuffed cookies and FroDo (frozen cookie dough). Scotcharoos, puppy chow and no bakes on request. One combo cookie changes each week.
- [Blazic Handmade](https://theblazics.com/handmade): Made to order. Plaster painting kits, resin coasters and seashell jewelry holders. Finished work also sold at holiday markets.
- [Blazic Gift Wrap](https://theblazics.com/gift-wrap): Hand wrapping for gifts you already bought, boxed or not. Busiest from Thanksgiving to Christmas.

## Ordering

- Request through the form on any page or email hello@theblazics.com with the line, the date needed and what you would like.
- We reply with a confirmed date before anything is made.
